theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_const_vector_massOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P m) (s : ℝ) (Ξ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ζ₀ α| ≤ s * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) m, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ₀ β = s) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Ξ ω = ∫ x, ζ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂ν) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Ξ.massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal s * ν W
